Mary Philips' husband was **Humphrey Bogart**, and he won his only Oscar for the movie **"The African Queen"** (1951). 

Bogart won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role as Charlie Allnut in the film, which he received at the 24th Academy Awards ceremony in 1952. He had been nominated three times for acting awards (for *Casablanca*, *The Caine Mutiny*, and *The African Queen*), but this win for *The African Queen* was his sole Academy Award.
